summary: Iteration 16 testing of SIDETRACK Final Product (8 integrations). Backend: 11/11 pytest tests PASS (100%) covering /api/sync/clock, /api/sync/room, /api/chat/{room}/history, /api/social/follow + stats + like, /api/rewards/credit-winner (full flow with battle/cover/vote), /api/discover/for-you, /api/lyrics/fetch (LRCLIB Hello/Adele returns real synced lyrics). Frontend: For You section, PlayerStudio (synced lyrics now load via fallback - iteration 15 issue is FIXED), Chord toggle + ChordDots SVG, StemMixer artist presets (Vocal Focus/Band Only/Full Mix/Drums & Bass), per-stem Solo buttons, SocialProfile follow-counts and live profile-stats all verified end-to-end. Brand color audit (no purple/violet/blue dominant pixels) PASSES. ONE CRITICAL INFRA ISSUE: WebSocket /ws/chat/{room} works on localhost:8001 but TIMES OUT through the public Kubernetes ingress (wss://...preview.emergentagent.com/ws/chat/lobby) — only /api/* paths are routed to backend. LiveChat falls back to ws-disconnected gracefully but real-time chat is non-functional in production. HTTP fallback /api/chat/lobby/history works perfectly.

critical.issue: Kubernetes ingress does not route /ws/* path to backend port 8001. Connection times out from public URL. Local ws://localhost:8001/ws/chat/lobby connects successfully, so backend code is correct. Fix options: (a) move endpoint under /api/ws/chat/{room} (since /api/* is already routed to 8001) and update LiveChat.js websocket URL accordingly, (b) request ingress config to add /ws path routing.

integration_issues.issue: Frontend connects to wss://host/ws/chat/lobby which is not routed by ingress (see backend critical above). LiveChat shows ws-disconnected indicator and 'CONNECTING...' badge indefinitely. Send-message form posts only via WS, so it appears non-functional through public URL.

issues: After clicking a tab, the shadcn Button focus-visible ring renders a cyan/teal background (~rgb(34,211,238)-ish) on the active tab. Brand requires Orange/Green/Dark only. This is the default shadcn ring color leaking through. Fix: add focus-visible:ring-[#FF6B00] focus-visible:ring-offset-0 (or focus:bg-transparent) on the BottomNav Button. Functional behavior is fine — text/icon color is correct orange #FF6B00; only the focus ring is off-brand.

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix WebSocket routing for /ws/chat/{room}. Recommended: rename FastAPI route to @app.websocket('/api/ws/chat/{room}') and change frontend LiveChat.js to wss://host/api/ws/chat/{room} so the existing ingress /api/* rule covers it. Verify with: python -c 'import websocket; websocket.create_connection("wss://vocal-studio-55.preview.emergentagent.com/api/ws/chat/lobby", timeout=5)'
MINOR (design): Override BottomNav active-tab focus ring to brand orange to remove cyan focus background.
OPTIONAL (cleanup): Battle/Star/Stream pages don't currently render LiveChat by default on mobile (lg:block only). On Stream desktop, the 'Chat' header toggle works.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1910 lines — should be split into routers (sync.py, social.py, chat.py, rewards.py, discover.py) for maintainability.
/api/social/{user_id}/stats counts recordings using {song_id: {$exists: True}} not filtered by username — returns global recording count, not per-user. Likely a bug. Should filter by username/owner.
/api/rewards/credit-winner relies on Form battle_id only; should also validate that the battle is closed/expired before crediting (currently credits any active battle's top cover).
/api/discover/for-you makes synchronous requests.get to iTunes inside async handler — should use httpx.AsyncClient to avoid blocking the event loop.
ARTIST_PRESETS testid 'preset-drums-&-bass' contains an unescaped '&' which is brittle in selectors; consider naming it 'drums-bass'.

rca of the issue: WebSocket failure RCA: The Kubernetes ingress in this preview environment is configured to route only /api/* requests to the backend service on port 8001. Paths like /ws/* are sent to the frontend container (port 3000) which has no WS handler, so the connection times out / closes immediately. Verified by: (1) `python websocket-client` connect to ws://localhost:8001/ws/chat/lobby → SUCCESS; (2) same connect to wss://<public-host>/ws/chat/lobby → TIMEOUT. Mitigation: change FastAPI decorator from `@app.websocket('/ws/chat/{room}')` to `@app.websocket('/api/ws/chat/{room}')` AND update LiveChat.js URL builder from `${proto}://${host}/ws/chat/${room}` to `${proto}://${host}/api/ws/chat/${room}`. No infra change needed.
